provenance.walkthrough: 00:50–02:28 studio: welcome, Hart & Murphy, Keegan tribute montage, leading into Newcastle v Liverpool; handover at 02:28 ("Your commentator is Guy Mowbray"). 02:28–12:56 Newcastle v Liverpool highlights (Elanga, Gakpo, Wissa, Szoboszlai pen) plus post-match interviews to 12:56. 12:56–19:51 studio analysis of Newcastle v Liverpool (penalty, Newcastle identity, Iraola's Liverpool), ending with Keegan tribute line and "Well deserved". 19:51–20:04 studio intro to Manchester City v Bournemouth, handover "Steve Wilson was at the Etihad". 20:09–29:31 Man City v Bournemouth highlights (Tavernier, Guehi, Gvardiol) plus Rose/Maresca/Guehi interviews. 29:31–34:30 studio analysis of City v Bournemouth (Guehi in midfield, Cherki, Maresca pragmatism, Rose's side). 34:30–34:39 studio intro to Brighton v Aston Villa, handover "Simon Brotherton watched this one". 34:45–44:26 Brighton v Villa highlights (own goal, De Cuyper, Hinshelwood x2, Gomes red, Kostoulas) plus post-match interviews including Emery on Watkins. 44:26–48:52 studio analysis of Brighton v Villa, widening into Villa's player exodus, ending "The big rebuild". 48:54–49:24 BBC promos/iPlayer trails, no match footage. 49:24–49:36 studio lead-in to the round-up of the rest of the weekend's goals, "beginning with the champions on Friday night". 49:36–50:00 Arsenal v Coventry City goals (Havertz, second, Odegaard). 50:00–50:40 Brentford v Tottenham goals (Lewis-Potter, Janelt, Kayode). 50:40–50:52 Everton v Crystal Palace goals (Dewsbury-Hall, second). 50:52–51:05 Nottingham Forest v Leeds United (Stach, late Leeds winner). 51:05–51:36 Ipswich Town v Sunderland (Emersonn, Angulo, Clarke winner). 51:36–51:55 Hull City v Manchester United (McBurnie and the second goal). 51:55–58:10 studio: extended interview with Hull assistant head coach Dean Holden about that opening-day win, tactics, squad and owner — analysis attached to Hull v Man United. 58:10–58:40 league table rundown and sign-off.
